# PhoenixStreamdown v1.0.0-beta.4 - Table of Contents

Streaming markdown renderer for Phoenix LiveView, optimized for LLM output

## Pages

- [Changelog](https://phoenix-streamdown.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

## Modules

- [PhoenixStreamdown](https://phoenix-streamdown.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixStreamdown.md): Streaming markdown renderer for Phoenix LiveView.
- [PhoenixStreamdown.Blocks](https://phoenix-streamdown.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixStreamdown.Blocks.md): Splits markdown into independent blocks for incremental rendering.
- [PhoenixStreamdown.Remend](https://phoenix-streamdown.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixStreamdown.Remend.md): Completes incomplete markdown syntax during streaming.
